title: ExtractionRunEnvelope
description: The manifest of one extraction run over one rendition: run id, adapter, source document hash, rendition hash, and the ordered, complete list of fact ids the run proposed. Content-addressed like facts, so a whole run can be verified or revoked at once. See spec/grounded-facts.md, resolved question 4.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 over RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical JSON of this object excluding 'id' and 'contentHash' — the same convention facts use. This is the run's integrity 'signature'; asymmetric signatures over the same canonical bytes are a documented future hook, not part of v0.

runId.description: The extractor's run identifier — the same value every fact in the run carries in assertion.extractor.runId, which is what makes run-level revocation possible from the run id alone.

adapter.description: The adapter that asserted the facts (matches assertion.extractor on each fact).

documentSha256.description: SHA-256 of the source document bytes; must match every fact's grounding.documentSha256.

rendition.description: The rendition this run produced and its facts' spans index into (spec D4).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the rendition text's UTF-8 bytes — the rendition's content address.

factIds.description: Ordered, complete list of the facts this run proposed. May be empty (a run that grounded nothing is still a verifiable, revocable run).
